name: Chornohora Ridge
description: Ukraine's highest mountain ridge, from Zaroslyak over Hoverla to Pip Ivan. Distances are approximate.

zaroslyak.name: Zaroslyak
zaroslyak.text: The trail starts at the old base in the spruce forest.

hoverla.name: Hoverla
hoverla.text: 2061 m, the highest point of Ukraine.

breskul.name: Breskul
breskul.text: The ridge opens up in front of you.

pozhyzhevska.name: Pozhyzhevska
pozhyzhevska.text: Meadows on both sides, wind in your face.

nesamovyte.name: Lake Nesamovyte
nesamovyte.text: Legend says a stone thrown into this lake brings a storm. Better not.

pip-ivan.name: Pip Ivan
pip-ivan.text: The White Elephant observatory stands on the summit. You walked the whole ridge!

story.treeline: The spruce trees thin out. Above you, only grass and sky.
story.ridge-wind: Up here the wind never stops. You zip your jacket and keep going.
story.white-elephant: Far ahead, a grey building sits on a peak: the old observatory.

quiet-stones.name: Keep Calm
quiet-stones.description: Reach Lake Nesamovyte without throwing a stone.

steady-pace.name: Steady Pace
steady-pace.description: Commit on 5 days in a row.
